map.照度限值依据什么标准？: What standard are the illuminance limits based on?
map.依据 GB/T 23863-2009《博物馆照明设计规范》：高敏感展品（书画、丝: Per GB/T 23863-2009 Museum Lighting Design Code: highly sensitive exhibits (paintings, silk, etc.) ≤50 lx and annual light exposure ≤150,000 lx·h; low/medium sensitive ≤150 lx; insensitive ≤300 lx. Lighting must match the exhibit sensitivity.
map.平均照度与中心照度为何差很多？: Why do average and center illuminance differ so much?
map.平均照度 E=总光通÷面积反映整体亮度；中心照度 E=I/d² 反映射灯光斑中心: Average illuminance E = total luminous flux ÷ area reflects overall brightness; center illuminance E = I/d² reflects the spotlight center peak (a point source attenuates with the square of distance). The spot center is often far above the average, so accent lighting must control both to avoid local overexposure damaging artifacts.
map.平均照度 = 总有效光通量 ÷ 面积（E = Φ/A）: Average illuminance = total effective luminous flux ÷ area (E = Φ/A)
map.总有效光通量 = 灯数 × 单灯光通 × 利用系数 × 透过率: Total effective luminous flux = number of lamps × flux per lamp × utilization factor × transmittance
map.光束立体角 Ω = 2π × (1 − cos(θ/2))（θ 光束角）: Beam solid angle Ω = 2π × (1 − cos(θ/2)) (θ beam angle)
map.光强 I = 单灯光通 × 利用系数 ÷ Ω: Intensity I = flux per lamp × utilization factor ÷ Ω
map.中心照度 = I ÷ d² × 透过率 × 灯数（E = I/d²）: Center illuminance = I ÷ d² × transmittance × number of lamps (E = I/d²)
map.光通量密度（标称） = 灯数 × 单灯光通 ÷ 面积（lm/㎡）: Nominal luminous flux density = number of lamps × flux per lamp ÷ area (lm/㎡)
map.光源数量需为大于 0 的整数。: Lamp count must be an integer greater than 0.
map.单盏光通量需大于 0 lm。: Luminous flux per lamp must be greater than 0 lm.
map.照射距离需大于 0 m。: Illumination distance must be greater than 0 m.
map.光束角需在 0–180 度之间。: Beam angle must be between 0 and 180 degrees.
map.利用系数需大于 0 且不超过 1。: Utilization factor must be greater than 0 and at most 1.
map.展柜面积需大于 0 ㎡。: Showcase area must be greater than 0 m².
map.玻璃透过率需大于 0 且不超过 100%。: Glass transmittance must be greater than 0 and at most 100%.
map.展品照度限值按敏感等级查表（高敏感/敏感/不敏感）: Exhibit illuminance limits are looked up by sensitivity class (high-sensitivity / sensitive / insensitive)
map.合规判定：平均照度与中心照度均 ≤ 限值才达标，任一超限即超标: Compliance: the verdict is compliant only when both average and center illuminance are within the limit; exceeding either one fails
map.超标比例 >2 严重超标，需减灯数/换低光通光源/加调光防紫外滤片: An excess ratio >2 is severely over the limit; reduce lamp count, switch to lower-flux sources, or add dimming and UV filters
